items.title: Tips for working with Kiro (How to ask, teach, and delegate) | Kiro: Zero to Hero 09
items.summary: Fifteen tips for getting better results from Kiro with fewer surprises. Say what done looks like and what must not change, put what you repeat into steering, skills, and hooks, split sessions by topic, roll back with checkpoints, and pick Autopilot or Supervised, the model, and the effort level. Each tip points to the deck that covers it in depth. Includes a running example (a meeting-room booking app). As of November 2026 (Kiro IDE 1.4, Kiro CLI 3.1). This is deck 09, in the Go deeper part of the Kiro: Zero to Hero series.

items.title: Skills and custom agents (Hand over procedures and roles, sub-agents included) | Kiro: Zero to Hero 08
items.summary: Hand Kiro your team's procedures and roles. Write skills that Kiro loads when a request fits or when you call them by name, make custom agents with a fixed set of tools and files (such as a read-only reviewer), and split big investigations into sub-agents that report back only their results. Includes a running example (a meeting-room booking app). As of November 2026 (Kiro IDE 1.4, Kiro CLI 3.1). This is deck 08, in the Go deeper part of the Kiro: Zero to Hero series.

items.title: MCP and Powers (Connect Kiro to outside tools) | Kiro: Zero to Hero 07
items.summary: Connect Kiro to outside tools. Add MCP servers with mcp.json, approve their tools, wrap an in-house API as a server, and load only the tools you need with Tool Search. Then install powers and build your own (a power bundles tools with the steps to use them), and see when to use MCP, powers, skills, or steering. Includes a running example (a meeting-room booking app). As of November 2026 (Kiro IDE 1.4, Kiro CLI 3.1). This is deck 07, in the Go deeper part of the Kiro: Zero to Hero series.

items.title: Steering and Hooks (Make Kiro follow your team's conventions) | Kiro: Zero to Hero 06
items.summary: Make Kiro follow your team's conventions. Write steering files that Kiro reads, add hooks that run on triggers such as Kiro saving a file, and use permissions and .kiroignore to set what Kiro can't touch. Includes a running example (a meeting-room booking app). As of November 2026 (Kiro IDE 1.4, Kiro CLI 3.1). This is deck 06, in the Go deeper part of the Kiro: Zero to Hero series.

items.title: 頼み方と成果物 | 目指せ Quick マスター 04
items.summary: Amazon Quick に頼むときの書き方と、答えの確かめ方、成果物 (文書、資料、表) の作り方をまとめた配布資料です。頼むときは、何をしたいか、何を見てほしいか、どんな形で欲しいか、の 3 つを書き、Quick が答えに使うものをデータの範囲と添付で決めます。確かめ方では、デスクトップアプリで選ぶ応答のモード (Fast、Balanced、Smart) と思考の深さ、答えの出典、数字の答えに付く説明 (Explanation)、間違いを減らす 4 つの確かめ方を扱います。成果物では、勉強会の運営を例に、Word の案内文、PowerPoint の紹介の資料、Excel の出欠の表と集計をチャットで作り、プレビューで見てから続けて頼んで直す流れを、Quick Web の画面で示します。会社のテンプレートに合わせて作るしくみ (デスクトップアプリと Enterprise edition だけで使えます) と、図と画像の作成も扱います。図の作成は、2026 年 4 月の発表では米国の 2 つのリージョンだけで使え、2026 年 11 月 9 日に東京リージョンのアカウントの Web で頼むと、対応していないと返りました。付録に、頼みの例、用語、出典があります。2026 年 11 月時点の公開ドキュメントと画面をもとにしています。シリーズ「目指せ Quick マスター」の 04 (使いこなす) です。
